relationships.subject: morphine
relationships.evidence_quote: We found that prolonged morphine treatment activated Tiam1 in the spinal dorsal horn and Tiam1 ablation from spinal neurons eliminated morphine antinociceptive tolerance and OIH.

relationships.subject: Tiam1
relationships.evidence_quote: Here, we show that morphine tolerance and OIH are mediated by Tiam1-coordinated synaptic structural and functional plasticity in the spinal nociceptive network.

relationships.subject: NSC23766
relationships.evidence_quote: Furthermore, co-administration of the Tiam1 signalling inhibitor NSC23766 was sufficient to abrogate morphine tolerance in chronic pain management.

relationships.subject: Tiam1
relationships.evidence_quote: Tiam1 is a Rac1 GTPase guanine nucleotide exchange factor that promotes excitatory synaptogenesis by modulating actin cytoskeletal dynamics.

relationships.subject: morphine
relationships.evidence_quote: Prolonged morphine treatment increased dendritic spine density and synaptic NMDA receptor activity in spinal dorsal horn neurons, both of which required Tiam1.

key_findings: Prolonged morphine activates Tiam1 in spinal dorsal horn; Tiam1 ablation eliminates tolerance and OIH.
Morphine increases dendritic spine density and synaptic NMDA receptor activity in a Tiam1-dependent manner; NSC23766 abrogates tolerance.
